title: Robotic Adrenalectomy With Versus Without Indocyanine Green Fluorescence Imaging
official: Randomized Prospective Study of Robotic Adrenalectomy With Versus Without Indocyanine Green Fluorescence Imaging
summary: This is a prospective randomized study comparing robotic adrenalectomy with versus without intraoperative indocyanine green imaging.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* adult patients scheduled for robotic adrenalectomy

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients scheduled for laparoscopic or open adrenalectomy or with an iodine allergy
